body:
1. # Death Indicator Mod – Summary

1.  Death Indicator is a simple and useful Minecraft mod that helps players easily find their lost items after dying. When the player dies, the mod automatically records the exact coordinates (X, Y, Z) of the death location and displays them directly in the death screen menu.

1.  This allows players to quickly note the coordinates and return to their death spot without searching randomly or losing valuable items. The mod is lightweight, easy to use, and perfect for survival worlds where recovering dropped items quickly is important.

1.  Features:
Shows exact death coordinates (X, Y, Z) on the death screen
Helps players recover items faster
Lightweight and simple with no complicated setup
Works seamlessly with normal Minecraft gameplay
